Zonder auth belanden berichten in spam of worden geweigerd.

  1. Inventariseer alle diensten die namens het domein mailen (hosting, Microsoft, ESP).
  2. Publiceer of corrigeer het DNS-record voor “SPF flattening wanneer je de lookup-limiet raakt” volgens de huidige syntax.

  6. Herhaal de kerncontrole voor “SPF flattening wanneer je de lookup-limiet raakt” vanaf een tweede netwerk of privévenster.

en.bodyHtml:
SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt belongs in DNS (TXT): one SPF, DKIM selectors and DMARC policy. Multiple SPF records break authentication.

Without auth, messages land in spam or get rejected.

What this article covers

You carry out “SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt” via mailbox, client and DNS auth, with backup awareness and verification.

Unique checkpoints

This long-form guide is written for SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt (slug spf-flattening-wanneer-je-de-lookup-limiet-raakt).

Signals from title/topic: spf, flattening, wanneer, lookup, limiet, raakt. Stay in the matching layer — do not mix DNS edits with wp-admin fixes unless this topic explicitly requires it.

  • Regression-test one adjacent flow (login, mail or homepage) after “SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt”.
  • If there is an error: keep the exact text for “SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt” — paraphrasing slows support.
  • When unsure between panel A and B: pick the layer topic tz-w2-th-mail-spf-flattening-wanneer-je-de-lookup-limi-0c4bd implies.

Scope

Internal classification: topic tz-w2-th-mail-spf-flattening-wanneer-je-de-lookup-limi-0c4bd — include that context in tickets about “SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt”.

What you need

  • DNS access
  • List of legitimate sending sources

How to execute

  1. Inventory every service that sends for the domain (hosting, Microsoft, ESP).
  2. Publish or fix the DNS record for “SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt” with current syntax.
  3. Keep at most one SPF TXT on @.
  4. Wait for propagation; test with header analysis on a received message.
  5. Raise DMARC from none → quarantine/reject only when reports are clean.
  6. Repeat the core check for “SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt” from a second network or private window.

Verify

  • Auth=pass in headers.
  • No duplicate SPF.
  • Article check spf-flattening-wanneer-je-de-lookup-limiet-raakt: “SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt” yields the expected result without regressing web/mail/DNS.

Pitfalls

  • Separate SPF per tool instead of merging includes.

If it goes wrong

  1. Restore the previous value you noted for “SPF flattening when your the lookup-limiet raakt”.
  2. Restore from backup only if the live state is corrupt — selectively where possible.
  3. Open a ticket with slug/subject, domain and what you already rolled back.

Practical tip

Tip: Start DMARC at p=none with rua reporting.

Note: DMARC reject without SPF/DKIM coverage stops legitimate mail.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
